lines.t: I walk this road with weight on my shoulders
The day is already long
I press ahead with what I'm carrying
Still I'm moving on
I lift my eyes and see you with me
Right here beneath the load
You're walking every step beside me Sharing this narrow road
I'm walking through this life alone With the weight of every day
But when I see you walking with me The storm begins to fade
The night grows lighter
The shore comes into view
I leave this world
I leave this world for you
I'm in this boat
Out on the water
The storm is all I see
The night feels shaped by all the effort it takes from me
But when I know you're here beside me
The waters start to slow
The night doesn't seem so dark now
And the shore begins to show
I'm walking through this life alone
With the weight of every day
But when I see you walking with me
The storm begins to fade
The night grows lighter
The shore comes into view
I leave this world, I leave this world for you
I wake up tired before the morning, the weight is already there
So I rise into another day and breathe through what it bears
I'm walking through this life alone, but I'm never on my own
Every step keeps drawing me forward
Toward where I belong
The night grows lighter
The shore comes into view
I leave this world
I leave this world for you
Thanks for watching!
